mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past two months signals inflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with subsequent FEDFUNDS increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month indicates a weakening labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with subsequent GDP decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a proxy for overall economic demand and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past month indicates a contraction in supply, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline > 1% does not correlate with subsequent GDP decline.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized over the past two months, the combined effect signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, the combined effect signals a strengthening labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% in the past month signals a weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline > 1% does not correlate with subsequent GDP decline.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 3% annualized over the past quarter, the combined effect signals an accommodative monetary policy with strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong economic growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 does not correlate with subsequent positive returns.
